messages:
maria: heads up — opened PR #8369 (roomsweep alloc tweak). microbench shows a small p95 bump on longseq workloads, need quick eyes before I merge canary. attaching short results and bench command.
kevin: pinging @maria — can you drop the raw numbers here? if it's <5% maybe we can still merge and ramp canary.
maria: sure. ran locally and on canary. command: `./bench/run_longseq.sh --variant=roomsweep --iter=300`

maria:
```
baseline: p50=18ms p95=120ms p99=230ms tps=420 mem_rss=6.2GB
candidate: p50=19ms p95=138ms p99=260ms tps=415 mem_rss=6.4GB
delta:   p50=+1ms  p95=+15%  p99=+13%  tps=-1.2%  mem=+200MB
```

philip: hmm p95 +15% on longseq is visible. do we see the same on shortseq? that would point to kv persistence/evict path.
maria: shortseq looks fine: p95 change ~+3%, p99 ~+2%, mem no change. logs show extra memcpy during shard compact step for long tokens.
kevin: can you paste the heaptrace or flame snippet? even a stack sample would help.
maria: pasted minimal flame: `roomsweep_compact -> copy_shards -> memcpy_block` in the candidate, baseline shows a skip path. suspect an off-by-one in the compact loop I changed.

philip: if it's a logic issue we should fix in PR. but if fix is risky, we can gate merge behind a canary with traffic=5% and revert-if-p95>+10%.
kevin: agree. also add a quick unit perf test around compact to catch this.

maria: will add test and push a tiny fix. canary plan: roll to canary pool c-3, 5% traffic for 2h, automated rollback threshold p95>+10% and error rate >0.5%.
ci-bot: [automated] created canary job job-20260314-07 for PR 8369 targeting pool c-3. monitoring hooks attached.
philip: thanks. @kevin can you spare a quick review once I push the fix? want 1 approval to proceed.
kevin: on it, will review in the next hour.
maria: added change, also updated changelog: "avoid memcpy in roomsweep compact path for long sequences". pushed new commit.
kevin: left 1 nit inline, but LGTM for perf fix. approve.
philip: approved as well. when canary green we merge and schedule a follow-up to add regression alert for roomsweep p95.
maria: merging after canary window if no regressions. will create follow-up ticket for an automated regression eval.
kevin: nice job catching that quickly. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [automated] canary job job-20260314-07: initial metrics reported — p95 delta +2% on c-3, error_rate 0.0%, mem +80MB. continuing monitoring.
maria: thanks — marking this thread resolved for now, will post merge ts once complete.
